						Amenities
					
										 
						Make the most of your stay, with a wide range of modern facilities and leisure amenities, combined with exceptional service and warm hospitality.
Keep up with work in our modern business centre, explore the wonders of Dubai or enjoy relaxing time by the pool.
Located nearby, this iconic clock tower is a historic landmark in Dubai and a great spot for taking photos.
Explore the famous Gold Souk in Deira, known for its dazzling array of gold jewellery, including rings, necklaces, and more.
Adjacent to the Gold Souk, you can immerse yourself in the aromas and colours of the Spice Souk, where you can find a wide variety of spices, herbs, and local products.

Enjoy a relaxing stroll along Dubai Creek, a picturesque waterway that separates Deira from Bur Dubai. You can also take a traditional abra (water taxi) ride to get a different perspective of the city.
Located in the historic Al Shindagha neighbourhood, this village offers insights into Dubai's cultural heritage with traditional architecture and craft demonstrations.
Explore the well-preserved historic district of Al Bastakiya, where you'll find art galleries, cafes, and a glimpse of Dubai's past.
This modern architectural marvel is a short drive away and offers panoramic views of both the historic and modern parts of Dubai.
Housed in the Al Fahidi Fort, the Dubai Museum provides a fascinating look at the city's history and development.
If you're interested in the arts, check the schedule at Dubai Opera for concerts, ballets, and other performances.
While not in Deira, it's a short drive away. This massive shopping mall offers not only shopping but also entertainment options like the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo and the Burj Khalifa.

					Relax atour Dubai wellness hotel
				
										
					Make the most of your stay, with a wide range of modern facilities and leisure amenities, combined with exceptional service and warm hospitality.  Keep up with work in our modern business centre, explore the wonders of Dubai or enjoy relaxing time by the pool.

Enjoy complimentary access to the Fitness Centre when you stay at Coral Dubai Deira Hotel. Our modern gym facility is fully equipped with an extensive variety of state-of-the-art exercise machines to meet every fitness level.
Step out into the city of Dubai or retreat to the comfort of our four-star hotel with its rooftop pool, sun terrace and jacuzzi, perfect for a day of relaxation or to unwind at the end of a long day.
Located on the Ground Floor, the business centre offers modern business meeting facilities that include private workstations, catering for any business-related needs.

													Gold Souk
											
                
          						
							Explore the famous Gold Souk in Deira, known for its dazzling array of gold jewellery, including rings, necklaces, and more.

point on map
						
													Spice Souk
											
                
          						
							Adjacent to the Gold Souk, you can immerse yourself in the aromas and colours of the Spice Souk, where you can find a wide variety of spices, herbs, and local products.

point on map
						
													Dubai Creek

point on map
